organisers.name: [{Keenan Darkins}{mailto:darkins.kb@gmail.com}] [{The Rubik's Cube Club at Ohio State}{mailto:ohiostatecubeclub@gmail.com}]

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzU1MDcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--ec0ee161ffe86155638e6beb1d566178f442949e/image.png) This competition takes place on a **Thursday Evening** and will only feature 3x3x3 Fewest Moves and 4x4x4. This competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the [many other competitions happening in Ohio.](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited. All minors must be accompanied by an adult for the entirety of the competition due to Ohio Union policy.
